title: Austin: FM Properties Lawsuit, Brackenridge Land
summary:
*   **Closed-Door Meeting:** The City Council convened in an executive session, meaning no public discussion was held on the agenda items.
*   **Ongoing Lawsuit:** Legal advice was sought regarding the federal court case, FM Properties v. City of Austin.
*   **Hospital Real Estate:** Discussions took place concerning potential property transactions related to Brackenridge Hospital.
